profile.summary: SpliceAI annotates sequence variants with predicted splice acceptor and donor changes.
profile.summary_source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: SpliceAI reads one-hot-encoded DNA through dilated convolutional residual blocks. Skip connections combine features at different depths, and a softmax layer assigns acceptor, donor or neither probabilities to the central positions. The 10kb version requires 5kb of sequence on each side of a scored position; variant scoring compares the reference and alternate predictions.
sections.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: The paper studies 80nt, 400nt, 2kb and 10kb receptive spans. Variant scoring averages five independently trained models; these are not five different assay results. SpliceAI-10k uses 5,000 flanking bases on each side. An input of length l + 10,000 produces predictions for l central positions; receptive span is distinct from maximum input length.

facts.label: Model type
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: Residual one-dimensional convolutional network with dilated kernels and skip connections; a softmax head predicts acceptor, donor and neither at each central position.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Inputs
facts.value: VCF variants, reference FASTA and matching gene annotation, or custom one-hot-encoded sequence.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Outputs
facts.value: Acceptor/donor gain/loss scores and positions in VCF INFO annotations.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Parameters
facts.value: The original STAR Methods specifies residual blocks, dilation and receptive spans, but does not state a complete parameter count for each released five-model scoring ensemble.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Known versions
facts.value: The paper studies 80nt, 400nt, 2kb and 10kb receptive spans. Variant scoring averages five independently trained models; these are not five different assay results.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Training data
facts.value: Human GRCh37 sequence and GENCODE V24lift37 principal protein-coding transcripts, split by chromosome with non-paralogous held-out test genes. The paper distinguishes GENCODE-only training from GTEx-junction-augmented models used for variant analyses.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.label: Training cutoff
facts.value: GENCODE V24lift37 on GRCh37 defines the documented transcript annotations. GTEx-augmented training is separately described; the paper does not give one common latest-data date for both variants.
facts.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

facts.value: SpliceAI-10k uses 5,000 flanking bases on each side. An input of length l + 10,000 produces predictions for l central positions; receptive span is distinct from maximum input length.

strengths.text: Provides direct sequence inference and an annotation workflow with explicit genome and distance settings.
strengths.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License

limitations.text: The command-line pipeline skips unsupported variants and variants outside its gene annotations. Code, model weights and downloadable precomputed scores have distinct licensing provisions.
limitations.source_locator: Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019, STAR Methods: SpliceAI architecture and Model training and testing (pp. e2–e3); README.md: usage and License
